description: Studies cultural allusions through audience knowledge, Ritva Leppihalme’s culture bumps, comparative joke patterns, and conversational responses. Explores how translation can preserve words while changing implications or targets, and how layered access lets outsiders follow a scene without flattening its local specificity.
